officialPortals.title: Consular information - Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Trade of Hungary
How to Apply For a Visa?

visaTypes: Residence permit for the purpose of family reunification

links.title: Residence permit for the purpose of family reunification
Application for a residence permit (form 9, EN)

docs.text: Completed and signed residence permit application form (or Enter Hungary electronic form)
Marriage certificate, birth certificate or adoption document proving the family relationship (marriage of a Hungarian citizen's spouse must be registered in Hungary)
Proof of means of subsistence (bank statement, income document, notarised maintenance declaration)
Proof of accommodation in Hungary (lease contract, courtesy accommodation document, proof of ownership)
Proof of comprehensive health insurance or means to cover healthcare costs
Valid passport and valid ticket or funds for return travel
One facial photograph; parental consent for minors
Preliminary employment agreement if employment is also intended (single application procedure)

visaTypes: Residence permit for the purpose of employment
Residence permit for the purpose of intra-corporate transfer

links.title: Residence permit for the purpose of employment

docs.text: Preliminary agreement on establishment of an employment relationship or document on legal relationship of employment
Hungarian Card: certificate of higher education or professional qualification required for the job
Proof of means of subsistence (employment contract, bank statement, regular income document)
Proof of accommodation in Hungary (lease contract, ownership document, employer's accommodation certificate)
Proof of comprehensive health insurance or means to cover healthcare costs
Valid passport and valid ticket or funds for return travel
One facial photograph
Agreement between the third-country employer and the Hungarian employer, if employed under such an agreement
Travel document with at least two blank pages, issued within 10 years, valid 3 months after intended departure
Completed and signed application form
One passport-size colour photo not older than 6 months
Biometric data, if applicable
Travel medical insurance valid in the Schengen area, minimum coverage EUR 30,000
Documents showing the purpose of visit (invitation letter, travel agency certificate, accommodation booking)
Proof of sufficient funds for the stay and return
Return ticket or proof of organised trip and accommodation reservation
Certificate of residence or legal stay if applying outside your country of nationality
Minors: statement from the legal representative and proof of financial means

visaTypes: Residence permit for the purpose of studies

links.title: The residence of the student / pupil

docs.text: Certificate of admission from the educational institution or document verifying student status
Proof of language proficiency required for the studies (language certificate or diploma)
Proof of payment of tuition fees
Proof of means of subsistence (bank statement, scholarship certificate, notarised family maintenance declaration)
Hungarian address declared as accommodation on the form
Proof of comprehensive health insurance or means to cover healthcare costs
Valid passport and valid ticket or funds for return travel
One facial photograph; parental consent for minors

visaTypes: Residence permit for the purpose of intra-corporate transfer

links.title: Residence permit for the purpose of intra-corporate transfer and permit for long-term mobility

docs.text: Guest investor: certificate of the qualifying investment (e.g. EUR 250,000 real estate fund share) and securities account manager's document
ICT: employment contract or letter of assignment with the third-country company (3 months' prior employment)
ICT: evidence that the Hungarian host entity and the third-country company belong to the same group
ICT: evidence of university degree or vocational training and host entity statement of experience
Proof of means of subsistence (employment contract, bank statement, income document)
Proof of health insurance, valid passport, return ticket or funds, one facial photograph

links.title: Information notice for persons entitled to a visa-free stay

docs.text: Invitation letter or other document showing the purpose of the visit
Valid travel document, completed application form and photo
Travel medical insurance (EUR 30,000) and proof of funds and return ticket
Visa-free stays over 30 days: report place of accommodation via Enter Hungary

entryRules.note: 90 days within any 180-day period; passport valid 3 months past departure and issued within 10 years
EEA, Switzerland, Andorra and Monaco; identity cards accepted for most
Only passports that include an identity card number
